assets.caption: V-12 Vent and D-12 Drain detail for NPS 3 & Up — Welded Piping, PNF0403
assets.notes: Engineering schematic showing V-12 vent (upper assembly) and D-12 drain (lower assembly) for NPS 3 and up welded piping. Labeled components include NPS 3/4 threaded plug, NPS 3/4 threaded valve, NPS 3/4 x 90(3 1/2) threaded nipolet (both upper and lower), and NPS 3 line size & up main pipe. Notes and dimension callout at bottom of page.
